label: Recordings to Anytype
info: Your recordings are transcribed, summarised and filed in Anytype. The steps marked "needs" come from packages that are not released yet; until they are, each is a note on the canvas, never a step that pretends to run.

name: Watch the recorder (needs monty)
info: monty watches your recorder and folders. It is not released yet.

name: Transcribe (needs innyrize)
info: innyrize transcribes and tells who spoke. It is not released yet.

name: Summarise (needs innyrize)
info: Summaries come with innyrize. It is not released yet.

name: Approve, send and schedule (needs a package not released yet)
info: A question before anything is sent, then sending and scheduling the next steps.
